summary.text: Mark Lepak is a Republican who represents Oklahoma House District 9, which includes Rogers and Tulsa counties, and was first elected in 2014. In the 60th Legislature he chairs the Banking, Financial Services and Pensions Committee.

paragraphs.text: Lepak built a 37-year career in telecommunications, and at his retirement in 2015 led teams of up to 800 employees across a five-state region.
His work history also includes farming, electrical work in a potash mine, and offshore drilling in the Gulf of Mexico.
He graduated from the University of Oklahoma with a degree in engineering physics and previously served on the Claremore City Council and the Moore School Board.
Lepak also serves on the Appropriations and Budget Finance Subcommittee, the Government Oversight Committee and the Energy Committee.
Lepak and his wife, an attorney, have been married for 47 years and raised five children.
